title: No demo yet, so I built a theorycrafter skill to stress-test my game’s buildcraft
author: puddhoggstudios
selftext:
I’m about a year into dev on a tactics / team management game that will (hopefully) feature deep buildcraft. That's the goal, anyway. 

Since I haven’t released a demo or test version yet, I haven’t gotten any actual feedback about builds or combos from real players. To fill that void, I added a Claude Code skill, /build. I give it a theme (“speed rogue”, “fire-bomber”, “Victor Frankenstein”) and it searches every weapon, armor piece, rune, ability, mastery and perk in the game for combos that fit that theme. 

It checks the damage math against the engine code, runs headless sims, and tells me where the available content is too thin to support the idea. 

So far it has theorycrafted 55 builds and logged 355 findings. I’ve shipped 115 of those findings as fixes. 

Then for no reason but my own fun, it turns builds into shareable cards (attached).   
  
**What’s the point**  
  
Buildcraft is my favorite part of tactics games, like FFT and Tactics Ogre.

When the skill comes back with a report on how it built a unit around the theme, it is truly exciting for me. I love when the skill figures out a combo I didn’t intend, or hadn’t thought of.

Honestly this is like 90% of the reason I even started trying to build a game. I used to run a hobby site for this exact thing in pathfinder, Pop Culture Pathfinder, where I would just theorycraft pop culture characters into the game. So fun to have the bot do it for me know, with my own content and engine.  
**What it can build with**

A unit in Crestbound is put together from:

* Main hand + off hand. 30 weapons so far, across 1H, 2H, off-hand-only and either-handed. Your two basic attacks come from what you hold.
* A 5-node mastery tree per weapon: an ability, weapon-locked masteries, permanent stats, and a capstone perk you can manually equip.
* Head / chest / legs armor with 2 rune slots each, plus a trinket board of up to 4 more runes.
* 10+ crest research trees of 50 nodes each (Steel, Holy, Alchemy, Tempest, Forbidden, Seafaring…). They hold abilities, perks, runes and gear unlocks.
* Head / chest / legs armor with 2 rune slots each, plus a trinket board of up to 4 more runes.
* 4 advanced ability slots and 4 perk slots

**Example findings**

https://i.redd.it/yueioxje301i1.png

https://i.redd.it/x8r5lak6501i1.png

I recommend adding skills like these for content audits. I have ones that regularly audit the code and update ledgers (Ability Ledger, Perk Ledger, etc) and flag problems that new content has created. 

If you’re interested, send me a unit “theme” and I’ll run it through the skill and share the card.

comments.author: lawlshawk
comments.body:
This is so cool. 115 fixes out of 355 findings before you've even got a demo is a lot.  
  
When the demo's up, I'd log what's offered vs picked too. I've tracked that from day one to see what players actually choose.
